Veterans Benefits: Oklahoma fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax for tax year 2022 and after (SB 401). Veterans rated 100% permanent and total, and eligible surviving spouses, receive a full homestead property-tax exemption and a sales-tax exemption up to an annual cap.

Description: Altus is a small southwest Oklahoma city built around Altus Air Force Base (97th Air Mobility Wing, which trains C-17, KC-46, and KC-135 aircrews). It is the most affordable city in this batch, with a typical home value near $100,000, an in-city VA outpatient clinic, and Oklahoma's full exemption of military retirement pay. Tradeoffs include hot summers, a remote location (~140 mi from Oklahoma City), and no local Costco.
